test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: Which Gram Panchayat has been conferred the **Gold Award** under the category **'Grassroots-Level Initiatives by Gram Panchayats'** at the National Awards for e-Governance (NAeG) 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kadepur Gram Panchayat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• The **Ministry of Panchayati Raj** announced that four Panchayati Raj-related initiatives have been selected for the **National Awards for e-Governance (NAeG) 2026**.
• The awards will be presented at the **29th National Conference on e-Governance** in **Jaipur, Rajasthan**, scheduled for 1–2 July 2026.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• **Kadepur Gram Panchayat (Maharashtra):** Located in **Sangli District**, it won the **Gold Award** for its end-to-end digital governance ecosystem, delivering over **1,355 services online** and adopting policies on **AI, Blockchain, and Robotics**.
• **Bijoy Nagar Gram Panchayat (Tripura):** Located in **West Tripura District**, it secured the **Silver Award** in the same category for its participatory governance and achieving **100% digital literacy among women**.
• **Rohini Gram Panchayat (Maharashtra):** This panchayat was the **Gold Awardee** in the same category in the previous year, **NAeG 2025**.
• **West Majlishpur Gram Panchayat (Tripura):** This panchayat was the **Silver Awardee** in the **NAeG 2025** cycle.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• The conference theme is **“Viksit Bharat 2047: AI-Enabled, Data-Driven and Secure Digital Governance.”**
• It is jointly organized by the **DARPG**, **MeitY**, and the **Government of Rajasthan**.
• **Incentives:** Gold Awardees receive **₹10 lakhs**, while Silver Awardees receive **₹5 lakhs** for project implementation or welfare.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• **Panchayat Advancement Index (PAI):** An initiative of the **Ministry of Panchayati Raj**, it won the **Gold Award** at the National Level for Data-Driven Governance.
• **e-Aarogya Dhamni:** An initiative by **Zilla Parishad Nandurbar (Maharashtra)**, it won the **Gold Award** for District-Level Initiatives in e-Governance.
• The dedicated **Gram Panchayat category** was introduced for the first time in **NAeG 2025**.
